changeSet.author: nexus-onjvw
changeSet.comment: Retire the RDR-205 v1 session ledger (ledger.yaml leaves the template registry in the same engine change): delete every nexus.tuples row whose subspace starts with ledger/, across all tenants, together with the nexus.tuple_deliveries and nexus.tuple_claim_log rows for those subspaces. Toggles FORCE RLS off on all three tables for the duration (nexus_admin is the owner with no BYPASSRLS, so an un-toggled DELETE would match no row on any tenant) and restores it before the changeset ends. Flat, splitStatements="true" statements (tuples-003-2's shape), not a DO block: tests/test_changelog_rls_lint.py's FORCE-RLS DML tripwire does not recognise a toggle nested inside a procedural block as guarding the DML inside it. Idempotent, and a no-op where no ledger row exists. DATA EFFECT: DELETEs every nexus.tuples row whose subspace starts with ledger/ (measured on the managed service's tenant 2026-10-31: 40,785 rows in 446 subspaces, all available, the newest from 2026-10-04), plus the nexus.tuple_deliveries and nexus.tuple_claim_log rows for those subspaces (none expected: the template was read-only and never claimed); irreversible — the pre-image is not recoverable and nothing should recover it, since the writer was deleted in 7.70.0 and no reader exists (documented no-op rollback below).
